name: LuluVdo / LuluStream Video Host Resolver Plugin
description: Resolves external video player iframes from luluvdo.com, lulustream.com, luluvid.com, and playmogo.com to direct HLS (.m3u8) streams.
author: TheDesiTadka Engine

steps: 1. Extract packed JavaScript block matching eval(function(p,a,c,k,e,d)...)
2. Parse payload, radix base, symbol count, and pipe-delimited symbol dictionary
3. Unpack tokens to restore readable JWPlayer initialization code
4. Extract direct HLS master playlist URL from jwplayer().setup({sources:[{file: '...'}]})
5. Play direct master.m3u8 from CDN node (e.g. *.tnmr.org) with Referer and Origin headers

headers.User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/128.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
